Liver tumour incidence after exposure to TCDD (NTP 2006)

Source: R/data.R
liver.tumor.Rd

Liver tumour incidence in female Harlan Sprague-Dawley rats exposed to 2,3,7,8-tetrachlorodibenzo-p-dioxin (TCDD); the current study of the EFSA example on informative priors, see TCDD for the historical study, and bmdefsa and fitpert for the analysis with an informative prior from the historical study.

Usage

liver.tumor

Format

A data frame with 6 rows and 3 variables:

conc

dose metric of TCDD as used in the EFSA example (EN-9902), not the administered dose; the doses of the study were 0, 3, 10, 22, 46 and 100 ng/kg body weight per day, by gavage

total

number of rats

incidence

number of rats with liver tumours

Source

National Toxicology Program (2006) NTP technical report on the toxicology and carcinogenesis studies of 2,3,7,8-tetrachlorodibenzo-p-dioxin (TCDD) (CAS No. 1746-01-6) in female Harlan Sprague-Dawley rats (gavage studies). National Toxicology Program Technical Report Series, 521, 4–232; from the package drcData.

Examples

# no tumours in the controls: background risk b1 fixed at 0
lmod <- drmTMB(cbind(incidence, total - incidence) ~ conc, data = liver.tumor,
               model = "loglogistic", family = "binomial", start = c(b1 = 0, b2 = 1, b5 = 0),
               fix = c(b1 = TRUE, b2 = TRUE, b5 = TRUE))
bmd(lmod, bmr = 0.1, def = "excess")
#> Benchmark doses, excess risk:
#> 
#>         Estimate Std.Error
#> 0.1:lf1     23.9      1.98
